name: quality-control-plan
description: Quality control plans and inspection reports from technical-drawing PDFs — tolerances, fits, threads, GD&T, balloons, Excel + PDF.
long_description: Hand Claude a technical-drawing PDF and get a numbered inspection plan: every dimensional tolerance, ISO fit, thread, geometric tolerance (GD&T) and surface finish is extracted automatically by Imnoo's drawing analysis, ballooned on the drawing and listed with acceptance limits and a measuring instrument. Choose the inspection class (100 %, Q1, Q2) and numbering style, then export the ballooned drawing PDF, the inspection package or the Excel measurement and inspection report — the same documents the Imnoo calculator produces. Only analyze_drawing uploads the PDF (to quality-check-protocol.imnoo.com, 1 free analysis per day without a token); everything else runs locally.

tools.name: analyze_drawing
tools.description: Uploads a drawing PDF (vector or scanned, ≤ 30 MB) to Imnoo's drawing analysis and returns every detected characteristic with type, value, page, position, confidence and printed balloon number, plus the title block.

tools.name: load_analysis
tools.description: Opens a saved analysis JSON — fully offline, no upload, no daily credit.

tools.name: build_quality_plan
tools.description: Builds the plan from an analysis: balloon numbering, acceptance limits, measuring instruments, inspection class and selection presets. Deterministic.

tools.name: export_quality_plan_excel
tools.description: Writes the Measurement and inspection report workbook (.xlsx) for the plan.

tools.name: export_inspection_pdf
tools.description: Writes the ballooned drawing, the full inspection package or the plan document as PDF. The source PDF is never modified.

prompts.name: create-quality-plan
prompts.description: Walks through analyze → review → export for one drawing.
prompts.text: Create a quality control plan for the drawing at ${arguments.drawing_path}: analyze it, show me the plan summary, then export the ballooned PDF and the Excel report.

imnoo_access_token.title: Imnoo access token (optional)
imnoo_access_token.description: The id token of your quality-check-protocol.imnoo.com login. Raises the drawing-analysis limit from 1 free drawing per day to your plan's quota.

qcp_app_url.title: Analysis service URL
qcp_app_url.description: Leave the default unless you run your own deployment of the Imnoo quality check protocol app.
